violations.why: irq_upland (prio 4) can preempt irq_drift (prio 2) between its two reads of v_quiver and write it, since pylon==1 after main.
irq_upland can reset v_wisp to 0 between drift's write of 42 and its check.
A higher-priority ISR can write v_wisp between drift's read and its write.
irq_upland preempts irq_reef between its write of 42 and the read.
irq_upland can write v_wisp between reef's read and write.
irq_kestrel (prio 4) can preempt drift and overwrite v_wisp before drift's check.
irq_upland can set v_acorn to 0 between drift's write of 1 and its check.
irq_upland can set v_acorn to 0 between reef's write of 1 and its check.
irq_kestrel (prio 4) can preempt irq_ermine (prio 1) and overwrite v_yew[K_CORAL] between ermine's write and its read.
